unitTitle: B2 · News and public claims: report without overstating
title: Grammar: Passive and impersonal reporting: keep the source and certainty visible
subtitle: B2 · Unit 2: B2 · News and public claims: report without overstating

steps.title: Passive and impersonal reporting: keep the source and certainty visible
steps.body: Use the active voice when the source matters: La porte-parole annonce… Use the passive when the affected result is the focus and the agent is known or irrelevant: Le rapport a été publié… An impersonal form such as il semble que softens a conclusion; it does not make weak evidence strong. For a claim you have not confirmed, the conditional can signal reported uncertainty (Le projet coûterait…). Attribute statements with selon / d'après and keep fact, estimate and interpretation separate.

steps.title: Passive and impersonal reporting: keep the source and certainty visible
rows: La porte-parole indique que la mesure sera évaluée.
The spokesperson says the measure will be evaluated.
Le rapport a été publié lundi.
Le projet coûterait moins cher, selon le média.
The project would reportedly cost less, according to the outlet.
Il semble que les données soient incomplètes.
It appears that the data is incomplete.

steps.prompt: Which sentence keeps an unconfirmed report cautious?
options: Le projet coûte davantage, c'est certain.
Le projet coûte davantage parce que demain.
Le projet coûterait davantage, selon le média.
Le projet a été payé par tous.
steps.explain: The conditional and source attribution mark this as unconfirmed reporting.

options: When the result is the focus and the agent is less important
Whenever you want to hide every source
To make a weak claim certain
steps.explain: Passive voice shifts focus; it does not replace proper attribution.

steps.prompt: What does selon le communiqué do?
options: Names the source of a claim
steps.explain: Selon attributes the information to a source.
